subject: NUMVAL-F function
notes: LANDED 2026-08-17 (PB60, with RV-15.67.4-1a — the same RenderDec arm). §15.69.4 r3: under standard-decimal arithmetic the returned value IS the numeric value represented by argument-1 (r2 grants only native and standard-binary the approximation). NUMVAL-F's standard-mode value is now the one NvfScan's significand × 10^(exponent − fraction digits), lifted through CobolDec.FromParsed — the ONE §8.8.1.5.2 r2 range check every SDIDI result gets, since a 4-digit E-exponent can leave decimal128 (1E+9999 ⇒ EC-SIZE-OVERFLOW). The refuter's headline — TWO returned values for one function and one argument in one execution (COMPUTE exact, DISPLAY the Int128 saturation sentinel, and NUMVAL-F("1E+30") = NUMVAL-F("9E+30") TRUE) — cannot recur under the standard modes: there is ONE SDIDI value in every channel (golden legs RAWF, F40, CMF20, SUM, and the relation/EVALUATE legs). The NATIVE-mode value is the same SDIDI (RV-15.69.4-2, kb/Work PB3839), so the value no longer differs by mode. NUMVAL-F is 2014+.
